Neubau (07. Bezirk) — Vienna, Austria

Relatively safer day Relatively safer night

In detail

Neubau's own district crime statistics, published via meinbezirk.at in May 2025, show car break-ins rising from 29 to 62 cases and car vandalism from 98 to 142 between 2023 and 2024, while building-damage cases fell; the article notes residents broadly report feeling safe and describes no street-level violence, harassment, or theft directed at pedestrians or visitors. Further searches on drug dealing, assault, or nightlife-area disorder around Spittelberg and the district's bar streets turned up no specific safety-relevant press coverage in the last several years. On that basis, press research found no particular safety concern for Neubau by day or by night; the documented crime trend is mostly vehicle-related property crime rather than anything affecting a visitor on foot. Sources checked: meinbezirk.at, 5 May 2025 – "Neubau: Kriminalitätsstatistik zeigt, wie sicher die Grätzln sind".
